address: 10 Soi Yen Akat 3, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok, 10120, Thailand
bio: At Sühring, twin chefs Matthias and Thomas present a modern German tasting menu influenced by family recipes, childhood memories, and travels. Each dish showcases expertly prepared seasonal ingredients using traditional German techniques such as fermenting, pickling, and curing. The restaurant, located in a restored 1970s villa, offers an exceptional dining experience, especially when seated at the kitchen counter....
